## Body

Verified in #286 at d55bb57caf09a5fe7d7d3a16226a7e1f90a1b922: activityPublished is the last successful acknowledgement, not the latest logical turn state. A control-context-only report based on it can reverse an in-flight agent_end idle (idle then working) or turn_start working (working then idle). Preserve the latest queued state for annotations and initialise it from the new runtime at boot; keep acknowledgement state separate for shutdown repair. Mutation probes against exact source confirmed both failures and a current-state fix probe passed. Magic wand: a delayed-transport fixture covering context arming and re-registration, so extra metadata never invents an activity transition. Difficulty: C25 forbids linked runner caches in read-only review trees, while boot currently recommends worktree-deps; exact-head CI remains the TS suite proof.
